## Summary

<!-- What does this pull request change, and why? Link the issue it closes, if any. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new feature
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation or RFC
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `ci` / `build` / `chore`: tooling and maintenance
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` in the title and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)

## How was this tested?

<!-- Commands you ran and what you checked. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing, and `go vet ./...` and `go test -race ./...` pass.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated where relevant.
- [ ] Language or semantics changes reference an accepted RFC.
